name: Feedback
summary: Customers leave private feedback through a link; you read it in your dashboard.
description: Share one link (or a QR code) and customers can rate you and say what they think. Only you see what they write. Optionally text each customer who leaves a number a thank-you. Every new entry also fires the feedback.received event, so an automation can react to it.

settings.label: Thank-you message
settings.default: Thank you! Your feedback goes straight to the owner.
settings.help: Shown to the customer after they send feedback, and texted to them if the switch below is on.

settings.label: Text a thank-you to customers who leave a phone number
settings.help: Sent from your registered number, and only to a customer who has not opted out.

resources.label: Feedback
resources.description: What customers have told you. Customers can add to this list through your link; only you can read it.
resources.title: message

fields.label: Your phone (optional)
fields.help: Only used to thank you, if the business has that switched on.

actions.label: List feedback
actions.summary: List the private feedback customers have left, newest first.

actions.label: Feedback summary
actions.summary: How much feedback there is, the average rating, and how many entries are not handled yet.

actions.label: Update feedback
actions.summary: Change a feedback entry, for example mark it handled.
